passages.text: Our class is arranging a visit from a local storyteller for the final club meeting of term. Mia offers to ring her up after school with our teacher present. The storyteller answers but cannot check her calendar while she is travelling on a bus. She promises to ring us back when she reaches home and can look at the dates. Meanwhile, we prepare two possible times and list how long the story and questions may take. The later conversation is brief and clear because both sides now have the information needed to choose.

parallelText.en: Our class is arranging a visit from a local storyteller for the final club meeting of term.
parallelText.zh: 我们班正安排本地讲故事者参加本学期最后一次社团聚会。

parallelText.en: Mia offers to ring her up after school with our teacher present.
parallelText.zh: 米娅提出放学后在老师陪同下给她打电话。

parallelText.en: The storyteller answers but cannot check her calendar while she is travelling on a bus.
parallelText.zh: 讲故事者接了电话，但在公交车上无法查看日历。

parallelText.en: She promises to ring us back when she reaches home and can look at the dates.
parallelText.zh: 她答应到家能查日期时给我们回电话。

parallelText.en: Meanwhile, we prepare two possible times and list how long the story and questions may take.
parallelText.zh: 这期间，我们准备两个可选时段，列出讲故事与提问大概所需时间。

parallelText.en: The later conversation is brief and clear because both sides now have the information needed to choose.
parallelText.zh: 后来的通话简短清楚，因为双方都有了作决定所需的信息。

wordHelp.meaning: during the time that another thing is happening

passages.text: At the final craft club meeting, our group is busy with a poster showing what we learned this term. We find several unfinished notes but cannot remember which picture belongs with each one. Mia says that from now on, each new sketch should have a date and a short explanation. For the old notes, we compare what everyone remembers and mark uncertain details rather than inventing them. Ben makes a simple example card that the next group can copy when its own project begins. Our final poster records both the finished work and a practical habit that will help future work stay clear.

parallelText.en: At the final craft club meeting, our group is busy with a poster showing what we learned this term.
parallelText.zh: 最后一次手工社活动时，我们小组忙着制作海报，展示本学期所学。

parallelText.en: We find several unfinished notes but cannot remember which picture belongs with each one.
parallelText.zh: 我们发现几份没写完的笔记，却想不起每张图该配哪份。

parallelText.en: Mia says that from now on, each new sketch should have a date and a short explanation.
parallelText.zh: 米娅说，从现在起，每张新草图都应写日期和简短说明。

parallelText.en: For the old notes, we compare what everyone remembers and mark uncertain details rather than inventing them.
parallelText.zh: 旧笔记则由大家比较记忆，标出不确定细节，而不是编造。

parallelText.en: Ben makes a simple example card that the next group can copy when its own project begins.
parallelText.zh: 本制作简单示例卡，供下一组开始项目时参考。

parallelText.en: Our final poster records both the finished work and a practical habit that will help future work stay clear.
parallelText.zh: 最后的海报既记录完成的作品，也记录让以后工作更清楚的实用习惯。
